name: Collard Greens

low.description: About 1 cup chopped raw or 1/2 cup cooked

siboNotes: Excellent choice for SIBO diets as they're naturally FODMAP-free and provide fiber that's generally well-tolerated. Cook thoroughly to improve digestibility.
preparationTips: Remove tough stems and ribs before cooking
Blanch in boiling water for 2-3 minutes to reduce bitterness
Sauté with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Add a splash of low-FODMAP vinegar to enhance flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of vitamin K for bone health
High in vitamin C and folate
Good source of calcium and iron
